metadata.repo_type_justification: Application source code (COBOL) with a deployable entry point (PROCEDURE DIVISION / MAIN-PARA) executed via JCL on z/OS mainframe.
metadata.archetype_justification: System reads from persistent employee master file (DB2/VSAM), performs calculations, and writes pay output records. CRUD-like batch operations on persistent state.

tech_stack.architecture: Mainframe batch (z/OS, DB2, VSAM, JCL, CA-7 scheduler)

findings.title: No Documented API Interface
findings.description: The system exposes no REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI interface. Integration is entirely through fixed-width flat file exchange (120-byte records) via plaintext FTP to an EC2 gateway, and direct VSAM indexed file access on the mainframe.
findings.gap: No programmatic API exists. Agent integration would require direct database access, file-based exchange, or RPA-style UI automation.
findings.recommendation: Expose payroll operations through a REST API (e.g., AWS Lambda + API Gateway) with OpenAPI specification.

findings.title: No Idempotent Write Operations
findings.description: The batch payroll system has no idempotency controls. Running the PAYRUN batch twice produces duplicate pay output records. No idempotency keys, no unique constraints, no duplicate detection.
findings.gap: No idempotency mechanism exists. Agent-triggered retries would produce duplicate pay records.
findings.recommendation: Implement idempotency key tracking and duplicate detection for payroll runs.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no idempotency controls on write operations.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system performs write operations (pay record output) with no idempotency key support. Agent retries would duplicate records.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add pay-run-id tracking with duplicate detection before writing output records.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Every write operation is idempotent — re-running a payroll batch for the same period produces the same result.

findings.title: No Asynchronous Operation Support
findings.description: The payroll batch runs 5-7 hours with no async patterns, no job status API, no polling endpoint, and no webhook callback.
findings.gap: Long-running operations have no async support. Agent cannot submit a job and poll for status.
findings.recommendation: Implement async job submission pattern with status polling endpoint.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event emission capability exists. No webhooks, no SNS/EventBridge/SQS integration, no Kafka topics.
findings.gap: No event-driven patterns available for agents to react to state changes.
findings.recommendation: Implement event emission (SNS/EventBridge) for payroll completion and employee data changes.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: No machine identity authentication exists. No OAuth2, no API keys, no mTLS, no service accounts. Only hardcoded FTP credentials in JCL.
findings.gap: No mechanism for agent authentication or principal attribution.
findings.recommendation: Implement service account authentication with principal attribution (OAuth2 client credentials or IAM-based).

blocker_remediation.immediate: Implement API Gateway with IAM or Cognito authorizer for the agent-facing interface.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Machine identity authentication with per-agent principal attribution in audit logs.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: No authorization model exists. No IAM policies, no role-based access, no mechanism to grant scoped access.
findings.gap: No scoped permissions capability. Any caller has full access to all operations and data.
findings.recommendation: Implement IAM-based authorization with resource-level scoping.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization. Cannot distinguish read from write permissions. No ABAC, no fine-grained RBAC.
findings.gap: Cannot enforce action-level access control for agent operations.
findings.recommendation: Design action-level authorization into the modernized API with separate read/write/admin scopes.

findings.title: No Identity Propagation
findings.description: No identity propagation mechanism. No JWT parsing, no OAuth token exchange, no user context headers.
findings.gap: Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 token exchange for identity propagation when building the API surface.

findings.title: Hardcoded Credentials in Source Control
findings.description: FTP credentials hardcoded in plaintext in JCL: username 'payroll' and password 'PayR0ll2003!'. No secrets management system used.
findings.gap: Exposed credentials in source control with no rotation capability.
findings.recommendation: Rotate credentials immediately. Migrate to AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation.

compensating_controls: Immediately rotate the exposed FTP credentials
Move credentials to AWS Secrets Manager or mainframe vault

findings.title: No Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging exists. No CloudTrail, no application-level audit trail, no immutable log storage.
findings.gap: No immutable audit trail for write operations. Cannot prove compliance or conduct forensics.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured audit logging with caller identity attribution in immutable storage.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no audit logging exists.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system performs write operations on sensitive payroll data with no audit trail. Regulatory compliance (SOX) requires immutable logging of all payroll actions.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Implement structured audit logging for all payroll operations with caller identity and timestamp.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Every write operation logged with authenticated principal, immutable and tamper-evident.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Capability
findings.description: No identity management or suspension capability exists. No API keys to revoke, no IAM roles to deactivate, no service accounts to disable.
findings.gap: Cannot suspend individual agent identities without shutting down the entire system.
findings.recommendation: Design agent identity lifecycle management (issuance, suspension, revocation) into the modernized architecture.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback
findings.description: No compensation or rollback mechanism. Batch runs to completion writing records sequentially. Partial failures leave corrupted state.
findings.gap: No saga pattern, no undo capability. Failed payroll runs leave partial state.
findings.recommendation: Implement transactional batch processing with commit/rollback semantics.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no rollback/compensation mechanism.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system performs multi-step write operations (iterating all employees, writing pay records) with no ability to reverse partial execution.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Implement transactional batch processing with ability to reverse partial pay runs.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Multi-step operations support compensation — failed runs can be reversed cleanly.

findings.title: No Queryable Current State
findings.description: No queryable state endpoints. Employee data locked in VSAM indexed files and DB2 on mainframe with no query interface.
findings.gap: Agent cannot inspect current state before deciding next steps.
findings.recommendation: Implement queryable state endpoints for employee records and pay run history.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No concurrency controls. Sequential file access with no optimistic locking, no version fields, no conflict detection.
findings.gap: Concurrent agent instances could corrupt state with no race condition protection.
findings.recommendation: Implement optimistic locking and mutual exclusion on batch runs.

findings.title: No Circuit Breakers or Resilience Patterns
findings.description: No circuit breakers, retry logic, or timeout configurations. FTP transfer to EC2 gateway has no timeout, no retry, no circuit breaker.
findings.gap: No resilience patterns for external dependencies. Gateway failures cascade without protection.
findings.recommendation: Implement circuit breaker and retry patterns for all external dependency calls.

findings.title: No Blast Radius or Transaction Limits
findings.description: No configurable transaction limits. Batch processes ALL employee records with no cap on records modified, no spend limits.
findings.gap: No blast radius limits. Erroneous agent invocation processes entire employee base.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable transaction limits (max employees per run, max total payout amount).

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State
findings.description: No draft or pending state. All operations commit immediately with no two-step approval workflow.
findings.gap: No mechanism for agent to propose payroll run for human review before execution.
findings.recommendation: Implement draft/pending state for payroll runs where results are staged for human approval.

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No configurable approval gates. All operations execute immediately without human oversight option.
findings.gap: Cannot require human approval for high-risk operations.
findings.recommendation: Design configurable approval gates using Step Functions with waitForTaskToken.

findings.title: Inadequate Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: Only a shared QA region exists on the mainframe — not a dedicated sandbox with production-equivalent data shape for agent testing.
findings.gap: No isolated sandbox for agent testing with production-equivalent data.
findings.recommendation: Provision a dedicated sandbox environment with anonymized payroll data for agent testing.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Unscoped in Output
findings.description: System processes SSN (EMP-SSN PIC 9(09)), bank account numbers (EMP-ACCT PIC X(17)), and pay rates. All data written unfiltered to output. No field-level filtering or access scoping.
findings.gap: B1: Sensitive fields unfiltered in output. B2: No access control differentiation. B3: No formal classification metadata.
findings.recommendation: Implement field-level filtering excluding SSN/bank accounts from agent-accessible output. Create separate access tiers.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND B1 fires (sensitive fields returned unscoped).
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: DATA-Q1 B1 fired because the system outputs SSN and bank account numbers without any field-level filtering. An agent accessing payroll output receives all sensitive fields.

b1.reasoning: Sensitive fields (SSN, bank accounts) written unfiltered to output file accessible to downstream systems.

b2.reasoning: No access control differentiation — single permission grants access to everything.

b3.reasoning: No formal data classification metadata exists.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Implement field-level filtering to exclude SSN and bank accounts from agent-accessible output.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Agent-facing APIs return only required fields. SSN/bank accounts accessible only via separately-authorized endpoints.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls
findings.description: Sensitive employee data (SSN, bank accounts) transmitted via plaintext FTP to EC2 gateway at 10.0.7.40. No data residency controls, no encryption in transit, no regional constraints.
findings.gap: No encryption in transit, no residency policies. Data sovereignty uncontrolled.
findings.recommendation: Replace plaintext FTP with encrypted transfer (SFTP/AWS Transfer Family). Implement data residency policies.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND sensitive data transmitted without encryption or residency controls.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system transmits SSN and bank account data via plaintext FTP with no data residency controls. An agent sending this data to an LLM endpoint would have no sovereignty guardrails.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Replace plaintext FTP with SFTP or AWS Transfer Family with encryption in transit.
blocker_remediation.target_state: All data transfers encrypted. Data residency policies enforced.

findings.title: No Selective Query Support
findings.description: No selective query capability. Batch processes all employee records sequentially. No pagination, filtering, or sorting.
findings.gap: Agent cannot query a subset of data — all-or-nothing batch processing.
findings.recommendation: Implement filtered query endpoints with pagination in the modernized API.

findings.title: No Input Validation
findings.description: No input validation at any boundary. COBOL reads fixed-width records with no field validation. No API boundary, no schema enforcement.
findings.gap: No validation. Malformed data processed without rejection.
findings.recommendation: Implement schema validation with structured error responses in the modernized API.

findings.title: No Temporal Metadata
findings.description: No temporal metadata. Employee record structure contains no created_at, updated_at, or event_time fields. No timezone handling.
findings.gap: Cannot determine when data was last updated or whether it is current.
findings.recommendation: Add created_at and updated_at timestamps (UTC) to all persistent records.

findings.title: No PII Redaction in Logs
findings.description: No PII redaction. SSN and bank account numbers flow through the system without masking in any output.
findings.gap: PII (SSN, bank accounts) exposed in processing outputs without redaction.
findings.recommendation: Implement PII masking for SSN and bank account numbers in all logs and observability data.

findings.title: No Data Quality Awareness
findings.description: No data quality metrics, completeness scoring, or freshness SLAs. Tax tables updated manually with no quality monitoring.
findings.gap: No data quality monitoring for employee master data.
findings.recommendation: Implement data quality monitoring (null rates, duplicate detection, completeness metrics).

findings.title: No Schema Versioning
findings.description: No schema versioning. Fixed-width file format (120-byte records) with no version identifier, no schema documentation, no breaking change detection.
findings.gap: Schema changes would break consumers silently. No versioning or contract testing.
findings.recommendation: Define and version the data schema. Implement OpenAPI specification with breaking change detection.

findings.title: Legacy Field Naming Conventions
findings.description: Field names use legacy COBOL naming: EMP-ID, EMP-NAME, EMP-RATE, EMP-HOURS, EMP-SSN, EMP-ACCT, WS-GROSS, WS-FICA, WS-NET. Somewhat interpretable but require COBOL knowledge.
findings.gap: Legacy abbreviations without a data dictionary.
findings.recommendation: Create a data dictionary mapping COBOL field names to semantic equivalents.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog or metadata layer. COBOL FD section is the only schema definition.
findings.gap: No machine-readable catalog describing available data and semantics.
findings.recommendation: Document the data model in a machine-readable catalog when modernizing.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — machine-readable spec is not applicable for this batch system.
findings.gap: No API exists to document with a machine-readable specification.
findings.recommendation: Create OpenAPI specification when building the API surface.

findings.title: No Structured Error Responses
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — structured error responses are not applicable for this batch system.
findings.gap: No API responses to structure.
findings.recommendation: Design structured error responses when building the API surface.

findings.title: Rate Limiting Not Applicable
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — API-layer rate limiting is not applicable for this batch system.
findings.gap: No API layer to enforce rate limits.
findings.recommendation: Implement API Gateway throttling when building the API surface.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface and no agent-initiated request path. Only mainframe SYSOUT operational output exists.
findings.gap: No tracing or structured logging infrastructure.
findings.recommendation: Implement OpenTelemetry and structured JSON logging when modernizing.

findings.title: No Alerting Infrastructure
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface. Alerting on error rates and latency not applicable for batch-only system.
findings.gap: No alerting thresholds configured.
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudWatch alarms when building the API surface.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface and no auth surface. No IaC exists — all infrastructure manually provisioned on mainframe.
findings.gap: No IaC, no peer review, no drift detection.
findings.recommendation: Implement IaC (Terraform or CDK) for all infrastructure when modernizing.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — API contract testing not applicable. No CI/CD pipeline exists.
findings.gap: No CI/CD pipeline. No automated build or test process.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with contract testing when building the API surface.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No deployed HTTP/RPC surface — deployment rollback not applicable. No deployment automation exists.
findings.gap: No rollback capability for deployments.
findings.recommendation: Implement blue/green or canary deployment with automatic rollback when modernizing.

findings.title: No Automated Test Coverage
findings.description: No automated tests of any kind. Changes validated in shared QA region only.
findings.gap: Zero automated test coverage. API behavior changes cannot be caught before production.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated test suite covering payroll calculations and integration points.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest. Employee master and pay output files contain SSN and bank accounts stored unencrypted. DB2 v10 (end of support) with no encryption.
findings.gap: Sensitive data stored unencrypted at rest.
findings.recommendation: Implement encryption at rest using KMS for all sensitive data stores.

evaluations.title: Structured Response Format
evaluations.reason: No API/serialization surface exists — informational signal, no finding emitted.

evaluations.title: Rate Limit Documentation and Headers
evaluations.reason: No API/HTTP surface exists — informational signal, no finding emitted.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no P0 priority assigned and critical path not established.

evaluations.title: Business Outcome Metrics
evaluations.reason: No metrics or telemetry surface exists — informational signal, no finding emitted.

items.summary: Resolve all 7 BLOCKERs and address critical RISK-SAFETY findings. Focus on building API surface, machine identity, audit logging, and data protection. Must complete before any agent deployment.
Address remaining RISK-SAFETY and RISK-QUALITY findings. Implement identity propagation, async patterns, query capabilities, input validation, and encryption.
Address INFO-level findings and engineering maturity improvements. Implement observability, CI/CD, IaC, and documentation.

recommended_actions.action: Modernize to API-first architecture with REST endpoints
recommended_actions.rationale: The system has no API surface — the fundamental blocker for agent integration. All other remediations depend on having a callable interface.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy centralized identity and audit framework
recommended_actions.rationale: No identity, authorization, or audit trail exists. Must establish before agents can safely call the system.

recommended_actions.action: Implement data protection controls for sensitive payroll data
recommended_actions.rationale: SSN and bank account data transmitted in cleartext with no field filtering, no encryption, no PII redaction. Immediate compliance and security risk.

recommended_actions.action: Implement transactional integrity and resilience patterns
recommended_actions.rationale: No rollback, no concurrency controls, no circuit breakers, no transaction limits. Agent-initiated operations cannot fail safely.
Payroll operations are high-stakes and irreversible. Draft/pending states and approval gates are essential for agent safety.
